detail: Transcribed 2026-09-02 from tactic-mainqa-deploy-auth-diagnostics (git archive holds the full node; serves strategy-autonomous-execution). Park reason: observable only in a real auth-class CI preview-deploy failure, or by deliberately breaking credentials on a branch deploy — cannot be asserted offline; migrated 2026-07-06 from the legacy gh main-qa queue. Checklist: (1) Root cause in the job log (was 2547) — a CI preview-deploy job failing with an auth-class error includes the underlying firebase-tools diagnostic output in the job log, not just the generic 'Failed to authenticate' message, so root-causing needs no offline digging. (2) No secret material (was 2549) — in that same run's --debug diagnostic output, no raw secret material (service-account key JSON, tokens, passwords) appears unredacted; only [REDACTED] placeholders stand in for sensitive values. A real failure can be induced by temporarily using invalid credentials in a branch deploy. Prior real-world instance of this failure class: the floating .node-version drift whose undici threw on googleapis OAuth (issue 2481).
subject: mainqa (author-required): Observe a real auth-class preview-deploy CI failure — the underlying firebase-tools error surfaces in the job log and no secret material appears unredacted
